sources.title: Identifying Hardware Changes
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Rigetti 超導控制：Rabi 面積與 π 脈衝
related.titleEn: Rigetti superconducting control: Rabi area and π pulses
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付等時窗對照、脈衝基線及噪聲頻段假說。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Mark each item pass, fail or insufficient evidence; a familiar brand is not proof. Final handover must include: Deliver equal-window comparisons, pulse baseline and a noise-band hypothesis. Every pass remains conditional on the stated teaching assumptions.
related.difference: 建立『Rigetti 超導控制：Rabi 面積與 π 脈衝』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付Rabi曲線、角度誤差與兩種原因的辨識表。
related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'Rigetti superconducting control: Rabi area and π pulses', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver a Rabi curve, angle error and a two-cause discrimination table.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：以 C(t)=exp(−t/T2)比較有效Ramsey與echo包絡；echo不消除能量鬆弛，亦非所有雜訊都可重聚焦。 使用教學t=40 μs、Ramsey有效T2=60 μs、echo有效T2=120 μs。 以手算或試算表計算名義式exp(-40/60)，另開一欄執行獨立核對：核對兩序列總延遲相同；用t=0正規化並把額外π脈衝誤差另外列出。
先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：共振兩能階模型P1=sin²(Ωt/2)；以f_R=Ω/(2π)表示時P1=sin²(π f_R t)。 使用合成f_R=10 MHz，t=50 ns；忽略失諧、洩漏及包絡整形。 以手算或試算表計算名義式sin(pi*10e6*50e-9)**2，另開一欄執行獨立核對：以θ=2πf_Rt先算角度，再用(1−cosθ)/2交叉檢查；ns與MHz乘積需含10⁻³。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Compare effective Ramsey and echo envelopes C(t)=exp(−t/T2); echo removes neither relaxation nor every noise process. Use Teaching t=40 μs, effective Ramsey T2=60 μs and echo T2=120 μs. Evaluate nominal expression exp(-40/60) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Match total delays, normalize at t=0 and separately account for the extra π-pulse error.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: For a resonant two-level model P1=sin²(Ωt/2)=sin²(π f_R t), where f_R=Ω/(2π). Use Synthetic f_R=10 MHz and t=50 ns; detuning, leakage and shaping are omitted. Evaluate nominal expression sin(pi*10e6*50e-9)**2 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Calculate θ=2πf_Rt, then cross-check using(1−cosθ)/2; ns times MHz includes10⁻³.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Google 同步讀出：IQ 雲團的可分辨度
related.titleEn: Google simultaneous readout: distinguishability of IQ clouds
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付等時窗對照、脈衝基線及噪聲頻段假說。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。

Final handover must include: Deliver equal-window comparisons, pulse baseline and a noise-band hypothesis. Every pass remains conditional on the stated teaching assumptions.
related.difference: 建立『Google 同步讀出：IQ 雲團的可分辨度』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付IQ投影、均值／方差表及保留樣本的混淆矩陣。
related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'Google simultaneous readout: distinguishability of IQ clouds', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver IQ projections, mean/variance tables and a held-out confusion matrix.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：以 C(t)=exp(−t/T2)比較有效Ramsey與echo包絡；echo不消除能量鬆弛，亦非所有雜訊都可重聚焦。 使用教學t=40 μs、Ramsey有效T2=60 μs、echo有效T2=120 μs。 以手算或試算表計算名義式exp(-40/60)，另開一欄執行獨立核對：核對兩序列總延遲相同；用t=0正規化並把額外π脈衝誤差另外列出。
先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：等變異一維投影以d=abs(μ1−μ0)/σ量化分離度；本題不把d直接等同準確率。 使用教學μ0=−1、μ1=1、σ=0.5，單位為任意ADC單位。 以手算或試算表計算名義式(1-(-1))/0.5，另開一欄執行獨立核對：同時把兩均值加10後重算，d應不變；用獨立標註樣本量測混淆矩陣，不能由d推定非高斯尾端。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Compare effective Ramsey and echo envelopes C(t)=exp(−t/T2); echo removes neither relaxation nor every noise process. Use Teaching t=40 μs, effective Ramsey T2=60 μs and echo T2=120 μs. Evaluate nominal expression exp(-40/60) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Match total delays, normalize at t=0 and separately account for the extra π-pulse error.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: For equal-variance one-dimensional projections, d=abs(μ1−μ0)/σ measures separation; d is not itself accuracy. Use Teaching μ0=−1, μ1=1 and σ=0.5 in arbitrary ADC units. Evaluate nominal expression (1-(-1))/0.5 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Add10 to both means and verify invariant d; measure a confusion matrix on independent labels instead of inferring non-Gaussian tails.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
